text:
Lena (CSM): Flag: TidalOne (mid-market, ~75 seats) dropped active usage ~41% in last 30d, renewal in 20 days. Proposing a compact 'runway save': 8-day enablement + 48h infra toggle + 2-week downgrade window. Low-friction, aim to restore adoption. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Marco (AE): I can do exec reset Mon 2pm PT. Need a tight promise 1-2 bullets: expected token reduction from enabling caching and a fallback offer.

Hannah (SE): Cluster shows prefix_cache=false. I can enable a canary toggle and run 48h metrics. Quick plan:
```
- enable prefix_cache on canary pool
- bump max_batch_tokens to 4096
- monitor: tokens/session, 95p latency
- rollback script ready
```

Priya (CS Ops): I'll add a 1-question pulse after enablement: "Did this materially reduce friction? (Y/N)" and capture notes if N. Link: https://go.redwood/tidal-pulse

Aaron (Product): If CS captures 3 failed prompts/reranker cases, we'll repro and check model variant. Also want logs for region-affinity on latency.

Lena (CSM): Proposed owners/timeline:
- Exec reset: Marco 1 Mon 2pm PT (prep by EOD)
- 48h canary: Hannah starts Mon 3pm PT
- Enablement clinics: Lena/Priya Thurs/Fri
- Feedback capture (3 prompts + logs): Lena by next Tue
- Commercial: Marco draft 2-week downgrade window language by Tue EOD

Marco (AE): I'll draft the downgrade wording and baseline usage numbers. Lena 1 can you pull last 3 invoices + 30/60/90 usage?

Lena (CSM): Pulling invoices now and will upload to the plan doc. Prefer to keep this reversible 1 not a permanent concession. :seedling:

scheduler-bot: Meeting created "TidalOne exec reset" Mon 2:00 PM PT (invite sent)

Hannah (SE): Will post 48h trial results (median/95p latency, token delta) back into this thread. If token spend drops >18% we have a practical renewal lever.

Lena (CSM): Great. If positive, I'll extract a short template 'runway-save' for micro-saves library. Updates here after exec call + 48h trial.
